label: Every first being is in act in some respect, from Theta.8 incorruptibility
meaning: A first being cannot fail to be (open analyst premise); whatever is simply incorruptible is in act in substance (In Metaph. IX lect. 9 n. 5-6 reading, d017b6b0); so a first being is in act in the respect of being, hence in some respect. A support option for 8288ff1e, not a weaker warrant: Control.ContingentFirst shows that 8288ff1e does not imply first-being incorruptibility, so the new premise is strictly more committal against the contingent-first-being rival. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
